name: RAECS / ECRS
full_name: Kagawa/BIT magnetorheological-fluid haptic master-slave catheter system (RAECS / ECRS)
group: Kagawa University and Beijing Institute of Technology (Shuxiang Guo; Yu Song, Xuanchun Yin, Linshuai Zhang, Xingyu Li); later Chengdu University of Information Technology
versions: guo2016_design (MR-fluid leader, force-sensor array) -> yin2018_magnetorheological (2-DOF slave, force sensing unit) -> song2018_performance -> guo2019_novel (T-RO: MR leader around a real catheter, fibre-optic tip sensor, collision zones) -> zhang2021_magnetorheological (catheter+guidewire system) -> li2022_collaborative (ECRS: collaborative handles, hydrogel + solid MR fluid, tremor-reduction structure) -> zhang2025_innovative (MRF master interface); 2007: S. Guo (Kagawa) "new catheter operating system" (Guo, Kondo, Wang, Guo, Tamiya 2007, ICME; Rafii-Tari 2014 Table 4 row 2) (rafiitari2014_current); 2014-21: J. Guo / S. Guo grasper-type slave (Belikov GU2.1-2.3): 2014 grasper, 2019 wedge-block guidewire clamp (ICMA), 2020 fuzzy PID, 2021 pinion fixture (ICMA), Liao 2022 (Alekseeva 2025 Table 6 row 5, Fig. 10f) (alekseeva2025_design; belikov2024_evolution; chen2023_operating; li2024_design); 2006: Harbin Engineering University with S. Guo, master-slave catheter driving mechanism for intravascular neurosurgery, two stepping motors (disk gear rotation, gear-pair axial drive), Internet remote control, bench precision test of a 2 mm catheter with a laser displacement sensor (Feng 2006 ICMA) (Zhao 2022 Table 1 row 24; Li 2024 Fig. 5A) (feng2006_highly; zhao2022_remote; li2024_design)
devices_driven: guo2016: catheter on a slave whose insertion angle adjusts 0-45 deg (guo2016 Sec. 2.4); yin2018 and guo2019: one 5 F patient catheter (7 F input catheter at the leader); zhang2021: catheter or guidewire held by an electromagnetic adaptive collet (Sec. 3, Fig. 4); li2022: 5 Fr catheter and 260 cm J-type guidewire at once, catheter and guidewire manipulation units (CMU, GMU) (Sec. 2.2, 4.4)
n_dof_detail: 2 for the catheter (axial, radial; guo2016, yin2018, guo2019); li2022 CMU + GMU move catheter and guidewire separately (count N.R.)
translation_detail: clamp-relay (guo2019: platform on two stepper motors, grasper A holds for insertion/retraction/rotation while grasper B holds the catheter during A's return; axial grip force 4 N, S8 reading of Sec. II-B)
rotation_detail: Rotation of the holding grasper (radial DOF)
footprint_mm: li2022 slave: 920 mm overall length, 400 mm CMU/GMU travel (Sec. 2.2); earlier versions N.R.
force_sensing: Load cell on the follower for proximal force; 1.3 mm fibre-optic pressure sensor in a 5 F catheter for tip contact force, working range 0-0.2 N (guo2019 Sec. IV-B); guo2016: load cell on the driven module behind grasper 1, plus a tip force-sensor array; zhang2021: load cell under the clamp; li2022: two TEAC TU-UJ load cells (+/-5 N) and two torque sensors for radial torque (Sec. 2.2)
haptics_leader: Passive MR-fluid haptic interface around the real input catheter; resistance up to ~0.5 N at 150 mT (0.4 N at 110 mT); three levels switched at tip forces 0.08, 0.10, 0.12 N (guo2019); ten operators noticed the step at 150 mT in 93 % of trials
validation_detail: In vitro only: guo2016 tracking and force-feedback benches with a vascular model; yin2018 ten novice volunteers drove a 5 Fr catheter through a rigid cerebral model into a wide-neck aneurysm; guo2019 ten operators in the EVE model; zhang2021 ten non-medical subjects in the EVE model with collision cues; li2022 tracking tests and six trialists inserting a guidewire into the EVE model with and without haptics; zhang2025 volunteers reaching targets along a 15 cm vascular-model path (Sec. 4 of each)
key_numbers: guo2019: axial positioning error 1.23 +/- 0.07 mm, rotation 1.57 +/- 0.07 deg; li2022: mean translation tracking error 0.94 mm, rotation 0.89 deg (abstract); MR resistance 0.16-0.5 N across 30-150 mT; guo2016: axial tracking error < 2 mm; zhang2021: axial transmission error < 1 mm (10 runs), 5 Fr catheter driven at 3.5 mm/s in the force test; li2022: CMU/GMU stepping motors 0.36 deg resolution
sim_model: VR catheter-operation simulators from the same group (guo2012_virtual; wang2016_virtual); no physics model of the follower found
